name: kiwispec
_site: The night rule for a request that names no night (the sequencer always names it): robofast/clock.py.
_calibration: MINERVA's KiwiSpec is iodine only: no ThAr or fiber-flat lamp (lamp_frames empty), and the slit-flat LED is not in use (slit_flat_led false). docs/kiwispec.md, Calibration.
_flux: The legacy exposure meter is not used: the flux record is the FAU guide frames the guiders report (POST /flux). docs/kiwispec.md.
